_comment: Same frame as the parchment master, matched by multi-scale normalised cross-correlation: full width x[8..3692] of the master over this image's 2560 px, vertically cropped to y[224..2296] over its 1440 px, isotropic ratio 1.4391 / 1.4389, peak NCC 0.6701. scale converts this source's pixels into master pixels; offset is where the crop starts.

record.notes: Immortal Empires feature image - the PRIMARY boundary line network for S3a. It is the same map as the parchment master with the lettering removed, which matters more than it sounds: on the master, a place name lying across a border merges the two cells either side of it, and no amount of inpainting fully recovers a boundary that was never drawn under the text. Here there is no text to occlude anything, so the cell network comes out closed. It costs coverage - the crop drops the polar Chaos Wastes, the far Eastern Steppes and the eastern edge of Cathay - which is exactly the gap the master is kept registered to fill, at lower precedence. Higher boundary precedence than the master (50 vs 40) for that reason. Contributes no coastline: the committed land mask is the coastline authority.
